name: TrustDemo
title: SMART Trust demonstrator: journeys J1 to J4
description: The user journeys of one cross-border family, as the VaxLink walkthrough tells them (birth-dose DVCs in Thailand, CHW registration and triage read in Lao PDR, clinic verification, vaccine-code mapping and schedule, family VHLs on one phone, viewed and audited back in Thailand) as a WHO SMART Guidelines L2 DAK and L3 implementation guide, built on the SMART Trust HCERT libraries.
